guidance: So what is the revenue growth outlook for FY27 and FY28, especially after a flat Q2?
But I would like to give revenue guidance maybe when we do our call for Q3 and see how this main season quarter goes, especially in the wine category.
risks: It wasn't a smooth ride in every state, and regulatory challenges in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh especially slowed things down for the whole wine industry.
In the premium segment, changes in the UP excise policy presented an industry-wide headwind.
focus: It is our core brands, our ready-to-drink portfolio, and the new markets we are opening.
Premiumization, Shotgun and wider distribution and entry into new markets will remain the key drivers of this growth for Fratelli.
So my first question was, which new product launches can investors expect in FY27 and '28?
